intent_record.intent_summary: Fixes memory leak in amdxdna_ubuf_map by adding proper cleanup paths for allocated scatter-gather structures on error conditions.
intent_record.what: Replaced direct error returns with goto statements pointing to new cleanup labels that invoke sg_free_table and kfree on the allocated scatter-gather structures.
intent_record.how: Ensures that allocated memory for the scatter-gather table and structure is properly released when either sg_alloc_table_from_pages or dma_map_sgtable fails, preventing memory leaks.
